memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Diabetes
  - Status: HbA1c 7.8%, FPG 138 mg/dL, weight 78 kg, waist 92 cm (>90 cm cut‑off).
  - Plan: Continue metformin 500 mg BD after food, glimepiride 1 mg OD before breakfast, sitagliptin 100 mg OD, empagliflozin 10 mg OD. Reinforce low‑carb breakfast, avoid sugary snacks.
- COPD
  - Status: Mild dyspnoea on exertion, spirometry FEV1 68% predicted, FEV1/FVC 0.60.
  - Plan: Continue tiotropium OD, salbutamol SOS, budesonide‑formoterol 200/6 BD. Ensure inhaler technique.
- Dyslipidaemia
  - Status: LDL 130 mg/dL, HDL 38 mg/dL, TG 210 mg/dL.
  - Plan: Start atorvastatin 10 mg HS, repeat lipid profile in 3 months.
- Weight & waist: Recorded as above; advise reduced portion size, avoid fried foods.
- Diet advice per meal
  - Breakfast: Whole grain toast, egg white, no sugar tea.
  - Lunch: Vegetable salad, lean protein, limited rice.
  - Dinner: Soup, steamed vegetables, small chapati.
- Due: Next HbA1c due 2025-07-05.

memories.author: patient
memories.text: I have been feeling more tired in the evenings and notice occasional wheezing after climbing stairs. My appetite is okay but I crave sweets after dinner. I have been using my salbutamol inhaler about twice a week.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Diabetes
  - Status: HbA1c 7.4% (down 0.4), FPG 124 mg/dL, weight 77 kg, waist 90 cm (at cut‑off).
  - Plan: Increase metformin to 500 mg TID after meals; keep other glucose‑lowering drugs unchanged. Emphasise post‑dinner walk.
- COPD
  - Status: Wheezing reduced, salbutamol use down to once weekly. Spirometry FEV1 70% predicted.
  - Plan: Continue current inhalers; add pulmonary rehab referral.
- Dyslipidaemia
  - Status: LDL 118 mg/dL, HDL 40 mg/dL, TG 190 mg/dL.
  - Plan: Continue atorvastatin 10 mg HS; repeat lipid profile in 3 months.
- Weight & waist: Recorded as above; advise smaller evening portions, avoid late‑night snacking.
- Diet advice per meal
  - Breakfast: Oats with milk, no added sugar.
  - Lunch: Mixed vegetable curry, chapati, dal.
  - Dinner: Grilled fish, steamed veg, small rice portion.
- Due: Next HbA1c due 2025-10-10.

memories.text: HbA1c 7.4% (ref 4-5.6); Fasting plasma glucose 124 mg/dL (70-100); Lipid profile: LDL 118 mg/dL (<130), HDL 40 mg/dL (>40), TG 190 mg/dL (<150 borderline).

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Refer to Pulmonology, Vikram Hospital, for COPD assessment and possible bronchodilator optimisation. Include recent spirometry and chest X‑ray request.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Pulmonology review: COPD GOLD stage 2, inhaler technique adequate. Recommended continuation of tiotropium and budesonide‑formoterol; add long‑acting muscarinic antagonist if symptoms worsen. No need for steroids at present.

memories.author: D04
memories.text: Chest X‑ray: Hyperinflated lungs, flattened diaphragms, no focal consolidation or pleural effusion. Consistent with COPD.

memories.author: D04
memories.text:
- Diabetes
  - Status: HbA1c 7.1%, FPG 115 mg/dL, weight 76 kg, waist 88 cm (<90 cm).
  - Plan: Maintain metformin 500 mg TID; consider tapering glimepiride if hypoglycaemia occurs.
- COPD
  - Status: No exacerbations in past 3 months, spirometry FEV1 72% predicted.
  - Plan: Continue current regimen; monitor for side‑effects.
- Dyslipidaemia
  - Status: LDL 95 mg/dL, HDL 42 mg/dL, TG 160 mg/dL.
  - Plan: Stop fenofibrate (not prescribed), switch atorvastatin to rosuvastatin 10 mg OD for better LDL goal.
- Weight & waist: Recorded as above; waist now below male cut‑off.
- Diet advice per meal
  - Breakfast: Idli with sambar, no chutney sugar.
  - Lunch: Quinoa salad, grilled chicken.
  - Dinner: Lentil soup, sautéed greens, small roti.
- Due: Next HbA1c due 2026-03-20.
